name: Mean Palm
description: Strike with a palm that stops at the mean point between the user's reach and the target's.

name: Midline Guard
description: Hold the guard on the exact midline of the body so that either flank is covered at once.

name: Mean Step
description: Step to the midpoint between two opponents so that neither has a clean line.

name: Mean Reading
description: Read the mean strength of a group by the pressure its qi puts on the user.

name: Tempering Lift
description: Even out an ally's qi so that no flow runs too hot or too weak and his strikes land true.

name: Mean Clasp
description: Close both hands on the opponent's limbs and lower his force to the level of the user's own.

name: Tempered Release
description: Draw the excess heat and cold out of an ally's body until the poison in it is spent.

name: Opposing Palm
description: Meet an advancing palm with a palm of the same strength so that both arms rebound.

name: Counterforce Guard
description: Push back at a blow with the same force it carries so that it goes no further.

name: Meeting Step
description: Step into the opponent's step so the forward pushes cancel and the distance holds.

name: Return Flick
description: Flick back a bead of qi equal to the one that struck the user.

name: Force Reading
description: Judge the direction and weight of a force that is about to arrive by its first tremor.

name: Eased Hand
description: Hold a hurt ally's limb in even hands and draw the pain and the swelling toward ease.

name: Cancelling Wave
description: Send out a wave of qi tuned to an incoming technique that cancels it where they meet.

name: Force Unwinding
description: Unwind a striking arm's force against itself so that the blow spends in the air.

name: Rebalance Fist
description: Punch at the point where the opponent's weight leans most and tip it back.

name: Poised Cover
description: Hold a cover of qi that tilts against each blow by exactly as much as the blow tilts it.

name: Teeter Pivot
description: Rock on the balls of the feet to the exact point of falling and step away.

name: Counterpoise Cast
description: Cast a weight of qi against the lean of the opponent's body to set him back.

name: Weight Sense
description: Feel where on a body the weight lies and how far it has strayed from its center.

name: Even Mend
description: Bring an ally's injured side level with his sound side until the pain is spread and gone.

name: Righting Blow
description: Strike a falling or reeling foe so that the force sets him exactly upright and open.

name: Tilt Check
description: Press down the high side of the opponent's stance until all his motion is flattened.

name: Poised Cleanse
description: Restore the even flow of qi in an ally by washing out the lopsided taint from a curse.

name: Median Palm
description: Strike calmly with a palm that carries neither haste nor sloth and breaks through by evenness.

name: Calmed Guard
description: Hold a still guard whose calm spreads over any blow that touches it.

name: Median Step
description: Take a step that is neither long nor short and leaves the body at ease for any next move.

name: Stillpoint Flick
description: Flick a drop of cold calm qi into the face to stop a rush of rage.

name: Median Reading
description: Read how far a person is from calm by the heat or chill that comes off him.

name: Calm Lift
description: Steady an ally's breath and heart with a hand on the back so his power flows without strain.

name: Quelling Hand
description: Lay a hand on the opponent's chest and still the frenzy of his qi until it is quiet.

name: Median Mend
description: Bring an ally's fever and chill to a middle warmth so that the wound can knit.
